mechanism: Naloxone antagonizes opioid receptors while prochlorperazine (antipsychotic) has CNS depressant effects and may lower seizure threshold; combined use increases CNS depression risk and potential for reduced opioid reversal efficacy in overdose contexts.
action: Monitor for reduced naloxone efficacy if opioid overdose reversal is needed; use prochlorperazine cautiously in patients receiving naloxone maintenance, and ensure adequate monitoring of CNS status.
